pointers.sentence: `lazy(func, *resultclasses)` defines a class in its own body, `__proxy__`, a subclass of `Promise`, and returns a function, wrapped with `functools.wraps` to look like func, that makes an instance of it holding the arguments it was given (`django/utils/functional.py:lazy`).

The class body writes some out: `__repr__`, `__str__`, the comparisons, `__hash__` and `__format__`, which the comment above them says are defined on `object` and so would not be overloaded by the loop that follows; and `__add__`, `__radd__`, `__mod__` and `__mul__`, which a second comment says certain operations on `int` and `str` need (`django/utils/functional.py:lazy.__proxy__`).
This is how a lazy value has wrappers of `str.upper`, `str.__len__` and `str.__getitem__` (`django/utils/functional.py:lazy`).
`Promise` is empty; its docstring says it is there to recognize promises in code (`django/utils/functional.py:Promise`).

A proxy is its own deep copy: `__deepcopy__` puts it in the memo and returns it, and the comment's reason is that an instance is effectively immutable, only a collection of functions (`django/utils/functional.py:lazy.__proxy__.__deepcopy__`).

`__reduce__` gives pickle `_lazy_proxy_unpickle` with the function, its arguments and the result classes, so a lazy value is pickled as the call it stands for, never as a result (`django/utils/functional.py:lazy.__proxy__.__reduce__`).
Unpickling calls `lazy` again, which builds a new class, and the value it returns calls the function at each use like any other (`django/utils/functional.py:_lazy_proxy_unpickle`).

Given a lazy translation, a function that works on text should not make it a string at once: outside a view, the documentation says, the active language may not be the right one (`docs/ref/utils.txt`).

`keep_lazy(*resultclasses)` decorates such a function: it makes `lazy(func, *resultclasses)` once, when it decorates, and the wrapper returns a lazy value of the call if any argument, positional or keyword, is a `Promise`, and otherwise calls the function at once (`django/utils/functional.py:keep_lazy`).
